content: विशोधनम् .²1 Cleaning, clearing (<ab>fig.</ab> also); राज्यकण्टकविशोधनोद्यतः <ls>Vikr. 5. 1</ls>. .²2 Purifying, freeing from sin, defect <ab>&c.</ab>; घृतप्राशो विशोधनम् <ls>Ms. 11. 143</ls>. .²3 Expiation, atonement. .²4 A laxative; <ls>Suśr.</ls> .{@-नी, विशोधिनी@} Tiaridium Indicum (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नाय, भुरुंडी</ns>).
